_doc: Elite enemies (EnemyGroup, BattleRules). On regular waves from min_floor, one enemy may become an Elite with an affix: tougher, worth more gold and XP.

shielded.name: Shielded
shielded.description: A barrier soaks the first hits. Breaking it shatters the barrier.

vampiric.name: Vampiric
vampiric.description: Heals for part of the damage it deals.

enraged.name: Raging
enraged.description: Below half HP it flies into a rage: hits much harder.

splitting.name: Splitting
splitting.description: When it dies it splits into smaller copies.

swift.name: Swift
swift.description: Fast: it acts early and often.

thorns.name: Thorned
thorns.description: Reflects part of the damage it takes back at the attacker.
